Source Evidence and Navigation
|-- [M] Resolve the repository: resolveDiagramSource [binding]
|   |-- Input: projectId + optional representationId, revisionId, contentId, sourceId
|   |-- [C] Load project -> require matching projectId -> select source context
|   |   |-- Live diagram -> validate diagram and requested contentId
|   |   |-- Saved representation -> load catalog -> select requested/current revision
|   |   |   `-- Require exactly one matching contentId or source-bound diagram
|   |   `-- Source-only request -> published bindings + project.sources
|   |       `-- Filter by sourceId; reject conflicting identities; require one binding
|   |-- Requested representation/revision membership is checked even with a live diagram
|   |-- Requested sourceId must match the selected diagram's binding
|   `-- Exposes source query, diagram, binding(), readText() and listFiles()
|       `-- Reads need an explicit binding and CorpusAccess; project ID alone is insufficient
|-- [M] Resolve mapped evidence: domain handlers expose selection and display models
|   |-- [D] Selected nodes + diagram mappings -> PanelContent
|   |   |-- Require sourceContext.contentHash == content.asciiSha256
|   |   |   `-- Checks mappings against diagram ASCII, not current repository text
|   |   |-- Resolve resources in diagram order; retain unmapped node IDs
|   |   `-- Deduplicate identical resources while retaining all selection/mapping origins
|   |-- Range target = projectId + sourceId + path + inclusive one-based lines
|   |   `-- rangeSha256 = SHA-256(captured originalLines joined with LF)
|   |-- Panel carries diagramId, diagram content revisionId and ASCII contentHash
|   `-- Display model preserves order: merge overlaps; split on file/repository change
|       `-- Backward line movement also starts a section; handlers perform no file I/O
|-- [M] Read current source: ProjectSourceService depends on [binding] and corpus access
|   |-- files(projectId, directory, sourceId) -> resolved directory listing
|   |-- source(projectId, path, sourceId) -> resolved text; reject missing path or NUL text
|   |   `-- [D] Full text -> lines starting at 1 + sourceSha256 + lspEnabled
|   |       `-- sourceSha256 hashes full text before line splitting, unlike rangeSha256
|   `-- Corpus providers expose directory, document and range reads
|       |-- Support git-worktree and filesystem-documents; path resolution stays internal
|       |-- Require matching provider kind and a canonical directory root
|       |-- Reject absolute/malformed paths, traversal segments and traversed symlinks
|       `-- Require correct target type; range reads validate bounds and clip at file end
|-- [M] Optional definitions: ProjectSourceService delegates to injected LanguageService
|   |-- No language service -> lsp-disabled; source browsing remains available
|   |-- [D] Lookup needs [binding].corpus + path + position + displayed sourceSha256
|   |   `-- Require supported TS/JS path and valid zero-based UTF-16 position
|   |-- [C] Read current file through corpus provider -> compare full-text SHA-256
|   |   |-- Mismatch -> reject and request reload before lookup
|   |   `-- Match + position inside file -> session.lookup with that verified text
|   |-- Result -> deduplicated repository-relative locations and LSP ranges
|   |   `-- Skip/count non-file or invalid repository-relative targets as outsideRoot
|   `-- [O] ProjectLanguageService owns lazy sessions keyed by canonical root
|       |-- Callers sharing this service share sessions; missing/dead sessions are replaced
|       |-- Private session owns child process, RPC connection, queue and idle timer
|       |-- [C] Await initialization -> didOpen(text) -> definition request
|       |   `-- Finally release cancellation resources; didClose if alive; schedule idle disposal
|       |-- Queue serializes lookups; request failure does not poison later requests
|       |-- AbortSignal cancels lookup; initialization/request timeouts dispose the session
|       `-- Idle expiry, process/RPC failure or service/process shutdown releases resources
|           `-- Disposal clears timer, closes RPC and attempts child termination
`-- [M] Inspect source: UI consumes service contracts and emits navigation callbacks
    |-- RepositoryFileExplorer uses CodeRepoService for listings; file click -> onOpen(path)
    |   `-- [O] Listing promises shared per service, keyed by project/source/directory
    |       |-- Failures evicted for retry; refresh clears project cache and reloads this explorer
    |       `-- Expansion is local; cleanup ignores late results without cancelling shared work
    `-- SourceCodeView renders supplied preview, ranges and presentation as read-only text
        |-- [D] Lines + highlighting/annotations + compaction metadata -> displayed rows
        |   `-- Folded gaps/comments can reveal whole sections or a graph node's source lines
        |-- [C] Ctrl/Meta-click or F12 -> source position -> optional onGoToDefinition callback
        |   `-- Caller performs lookup; supplied navigationRange expands its destination fold
        `-- [O] View owns fold/token state; optional external scrollState retains offsets
            `-- Ignore obsolete tokenization and hidden-view zero offsets; plain text is fallback
